tasks.title: Freeze the comparable peer harness
tasks.objective: Pre-register one reproducible harness for overlapping ctxmux, tmux, and Zellij semantics before performance results guide implementation.
tasks.outcome: Every measured workload, environment, metric, statistical rule, practical margin, and comparability boundary is immutable for the cycle.
acceptance: Pinned peer versions, hardware and toolchain identity, child workload, warm-up, sampling, failure handling, and raw-result schema are explicit.
Comparable start, first output, attach, input-to-output, replay, throughput, fan-out, shutdown, CPU, RSS, descriptor, and thread metrics are frozen before candidate results.
Each metric declares direction, practical margin, statistical rule, noise budget, and semantic exclusions; incomparable behavior is reviewed before measurement.
Harness self-tests prove workload parity, unit normalization, completeness, failed-process handling, and report reproducibility.

verification.proves: The pinned peer harness executes every frozen workload and emits complete machine-readable results.
Comparability, environments, statistics, and immutable cycle rules are reviewable.

tasks.title: Measure and decide raw-byte ROI
tasks.objective: Profile the clean incremental consumer path and change its byte representation only when one frozen material-benefit rule exceeds protocol and maintenance cost.
tasks.outcome: The cycle either earns a simpler faster exact-byte path or records a valid no-change decision without speculative protocol churn.
acceptance: Profiles cover the current integer-array wire path and the smallest viable alternatives under frozen chunk, replay, fan-out, rate, latency, CPU, RSS, wire-byte, and event-loop metrics.
A representation changes only when it meets the predeclared material-benefit and no-regression rules; otherwise the current representation is retained.
Any selected path preserves arbitrary fragmented bytes, sequence, replay/live join, truncation, Gap, frame limits, validation, backpressure, security, and cross-language behavior.
No negotiation fallback, dual encoding, compatibility alias, renderer snapshot, or benchmark-only shortcut is added.

verification.proves: The frozen streaming workload supports the predeclared change-or-retain decision.
The selected or retained path preserves ordinary correctness and reliability gates.

tasks.title: Record the bounded-cycle result
tasks.objective: Remeasure once, independently reproduce the complete comparison, and close the fixed cycle with honest outcomes and an explicit next-cycle decision.
tasks.outcome: Repo-local raw data and a reproducible report show wins, ties, losses, variance, and scope without keeping Kernel or release work open.
acceptance: One bounded optimize-and-remeasure pass stays inside the pre-registered time and complexity budget.
Every result remains traceable to exact source, peer versions, hardware, toolchains, commands, raw samples, and comparability decisions.
Independent reproduction rebuilds the report from clean raw evidence and confirms correctness gates remain green.
Wins, ties, and losses are all reported; no workload, peer, percentile, or resource metric is removed after results.
The task records repo-local evidence only; publishing results, pushing refs, or mutating a hosted system still requires explicit authorization.
The report records an explicit stop or separately reviewed next-cycle proposal; it does not silently extend this Feature.

verification.proves: The complete frozen comparison and independent reproduction are machine-checkable.
Raw evidence, outcomes, variance, limits, and next-cycle disposition are auditable.
